title: ADS-B 1090 MHz: six aircraft, some messages colliding
description: tools/scene_six.json, 6 s looped: ANZ123 (C81A2B, 40 deg), QFA44 (7C4A51, 95), UAL917 (A0B1C2, 150), BAW12 (406B90, 215), ZKTCA (C82F11, a light aircraft at 3500 ft, 270) and DLH410 (3C4AD7, 330) send DF17 identification, airborne positions (CPR even / odd), velocities and DF11 all-call replies, 17-25 dB over the noise, each with its own carrier offset; three pairs of messages overlap. Positions 25-120 km from the station at their compass bearings (heading 0), fixed (the loop). Expect a talker per aircraft (its ICAO address) at those bearings; tick Plot on map to see them.
